items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Sure. He tried out and left.

ctx.x: I'd like to mention a few names to you, like David Nelson, King Oliver's nephew, who apparently tried to make it with the Russell band at one time. Were you there at the time when he was tried out?
Sure. He tried out and left. No, he couldn't make it at all. We needed a trumpet player with some get-up-and-go, you know. He didn't have that.
